২৭. *American Secret Documents, Foreign Relations, 1969-1976, Vol-XI, South Asian Crisis, 1971*, Released by the Office of The Historian, “Telegram From the department of State to the Embassy in Pakistan, Washington April 17, 1971, Subject: Provisional Government of Bangladesh, Page-43, “Pakistan Ambassador Hilaly told Van Hollen of instructions April 16 that Government of Pakistan wished to bring to USG’s attention possible approach by representatives alleging to represent "Provisional Government of Bangladesh.” Hilaly said India had permitted establishment provisional government on its territory and was providing financial support. In GOP view, such provisional government exists only in GOI’s imagination, is designed to justify Indian intervention, and to aggravate already serious situation. Hilaly said GOP understands that several representatives of so-called Provisional Government already have gone abroad to seek support. One such representative. Zakaria Choudhury, has already arrived in London. According Reuter news report London, April 15, he has held press conference and has been interviewed on BBC, claiming that Bengali separatists control three fourths of East Pakistan.
